_meta.note: Captured off the wire from opencode acp 1.19.1, the Real Adapter Contract lane pin (test/real_adapters/package.json), driven over stdio by a scratch client against a loopback OpenAI-compatible model stub with a throwaway HOME, so no real model or credential was involved. The project permission was ask, the routing Crew seeds. session/new carried one stdio element named probe: a stub MCP server whose tools/list answers one tool, lookup. The stub model calls probe_lookup once with {owner, issue_number}. The permission request names the tool only by its MCP key in title (probe_lookup) with rawInput {}; the in-progress tool_call_update that follows the answer carries the arguments, and the stub server log showed tools/call params.arguments equal to that rawInput. Reductions: the session id is synthetic, the scratch directory reads ~, available_commands_update and usage_update frames are dropped, each configOptions select keeps only its current value, one message chunk is kept.
